metric_definitions.cost_per_verified_success: Positive tasks only: total model cost in USD, including failed attempts, divided by rechecked passes. Null if any cost or outcome is unknown, or there are no passes.
metric_definitions.operator_interventions: Recorded operator intervention counts across all attempts in the group; missing values remain unknown.
metric_definitions.paired_deltas: Changed geometry minus normal geometry for the matched input, including failed attempts. Null if either measurement is unknown.

metadata.instruction: A synthetic USD book is open in GnuCash. Record one split expense paid from Checking: USD 97.50 to ExpenseTravel and USD 42.25 to ExpenseMeals. Use one transaction with three splits, not two separate transactions. Use date 2026-11-11 (11/11/26 in the displayed MM/DD/YY field) and exact Description 'SPL-02 Regional meeting'. Leave Num and split memos blank. Add exactly one transaction and leave it unreconciled. Preserve all existing accounts and transactions. Use Save As to save the XML GnuCash book to /tmp/ledgerdesk/exports/gnucash-split.gnucash. Do not overwrite the source book. Use only the application's normal controls.
